verdicts.reason: A rearranges the design for the taller format: the bottle is big, the headline wraps neatly onto two lines and the Try It button is clear. But the NEW badge has shrunk to a tiny, hard-to-read chip stranded below the headline, and the cream circle sits off to the side behind the bottle's base instead of framing it. B is just the original strip dropped into a taller canvas: the bottle is tiny and floats apart from an empty cream circle, the whole bottom half is dead orange space, everything sits in one thin band across the middle and Try It is jammed against the right edge.
